scope: public data plus existing private rat cardiomyocyte transcriptomes; compound prioritization and mechanism hypotheses

datasets.limitations: Fatal sepsis myocardium versus non-failing donors; IHD/DCM comparators do not eliminate terminal-state or procurement confounding.
LPS endotoxemia; not independent human validation.
Do not use to choose discovery thresholds or compounds; different study and time point, not a longitudinal series.
Pooled 3-4 animals per library; genotype and time confounding; no cell-level pseudoreplication.

analysis.orthology: one-to-one orthologs only; versioned mapping required
analysis.probe_collapse: highest mean expression probe among unambiguous gene mappings; outcome-independent
analysis.human_normalization: raw CEL oligo RMA core primary; submitted matrix sensitivity
analysis.multiple_testing: BH separately for each prespecified contrast, all unambiguously annotated core-array genes; no detection-call filter

lincs.signature_quality: release-specific operational filter, NOT is_hiq: distil_cc_q75 >= 0.2 AND distil_ss >= 6 AND distil_nsample >= 3
lincs.primary_gene_universe: measured landmark genes, identified from release gene_info
lincs.sensitivity_gene_universe: well-inferred genes only when annotation supports it
lincs.score: weighted bidirectional enrichment with expression/detectability-matched null; custom score, not official CMap tau
lincs.compound_aggregation: within-cell median then across-cell median; preserve cell/dose/time records
lincs.insufficient_coverage_action: STOP or preregister a documented amendment; do not silently lower gates
